card.name: Creatinine and diarrhea in warnings
card.fires_on: The final part of "creatinine" (the "inine" ending) after "serum creat" in kidney-monitoring instructions. Also the word "diarrhea" after "if" or "severe" in warnings.

modes.label: Creatinine monitoring

modes.label: Diarrhea warning

modes.label: Enzyme name ending
modes.description: The ending of "oxidase" in the name monoamine oxidase inhibitors.
